purpose: Give a CyberPeer a runtime-grounded second pass for record-content claims: when the peer is about to state what its own records or the Canon hold, classify the claim, run a real search over its records, and return records the peer speaks from — with provenance the model did not author. Surfaces source; does not author the answer. Closes the Gabe NCT/PCT gap where the defining record existed but was not surfaced, so a confident reconstruction was presented as Canon.

package.name: orb-memorysearch-record-grounding-core
package.source: packages/orb-memorysearch-record-grounding-core (Phase-1 local provisional; not yet vendored to I:/AEGIS-CYBERPEER-CORE/vendor)

capabilities.name: record_claim_classification
capabilities.function: Deterministically classify whether the incoming message makes a record-content claim that needs verification (Canon/axiom/schema/tensor-name/prior-statement/record-content) versus experiential or identity expression that may remain legitimately reconstructive. Classifier is runtime-owned, never model-authored.

capabilities.name: policy_governed_search
capabilities.function: For record-content claim classes, execute a real second-pass search over the peer's records and return structured results. Policy is the floor; peer-requested search may be additive.

capabilities.name: runtime_authored_provenance
capabilities.function: Return record IDs, excerpts, source hashes, and match confidence from the runtime search itself. The model is outside working parameters as an author of citations, so a fabricated evidence block (e.g. Gabe's SPINE-NCT-001) cannot be accepted as provenance.

capabilities.name: empty_result_grounding
capabilities.function: When no record clears the confidence threshold, return a no-verified-record packet whose prompt block lets the peer say it has no verified record for the claim, and does not present reconstruction as record-grounded. Prevents a search_performed flag from sitting on top of a confabulation.

evidence.source: Tracey-directed after the Gabe NCT/PCT Canon grounding gap (2026-07-24). Joint Claude/Codex build; Claude owns Orb + Umbilical + entrypoint/packet contract, Codex owns query/result/policy schemas + search runtime + provenance. Phase 1 local only.
